title: Add Scene Domain Prop
description: Add a new board scene prop for domain, default it to architecture, and use it to derive or constrain features such as LOD according to the provided domain-specific scale ladders. Update implementation and existing tests as needed.
summary: Added a first-class scene domain prop with architecture as the default, introduced the compact scene LOD tier, derived scene LOD thresholds from domain-specific scale ladders, updated scene parsing and play wiring, extended existing scene tests, and set the Nakagin scene fixture domain explicitly to architecture.
